objective: Retire remaining legacy economic authority paths and introduce read-only Treasury Economic Intelligence without creating a second economic authority or scheduler.
changes: Added read-only TreasuryEconomicIntelligence over the durable Treasury ledger.
Added bounded spend forecasts and active reservation-capacity pressure signals.
Added TreasuryEconomicAdvice shadow projection without Treasury mutation capability.
Exposed read-only admin Treasury economics API and operator panel.
Retired CostGovernor from CapabilityFirstRouter production authority path.
Removed MissionBudgetManager from MissionManager economic enforcement; duration/parallelism remain mission lifecycle constraints.
Made TreasuryQuotaAdmission authoritative after one-time legacy quota bootstrap; Firestore remains projection.
Moved user/admin/Overseer quota reads to Treasury.
Collapsed /api/generations into the canonical /api/generate-video compatibility facade.
Removed scheduler-owned quota admission and delegated generation to canonical Treasury-gated flow.
Routed specialized quiz/model endpoints through Treasury-managed providerFactory.
Bound Economic Intelligence into Overseer Decision Fabric as advisory-only context.
Updated Treasurer .okf hierarchy, economic contract, decision record, and Wave 4 documentation.
invariants: Treasurer remains the only production economic admission authority.
Economic Intelligence is read-only and cannot mutate Treasury.
Each additional model/provider attempt requires a fresh Treasury reservation.
Legacy Firestore quota is bootstrap/projection only.
Free monetary cost does not imply unlimited scarce capacity.
Ascalon/GLiDE receives only a bounded projection and cannot authorize Treasury spend.

notes: Treasury remains the deterministic economic authority; Economic Intelligence is read-only advisory context.
Legacy CostGovernor and MissionBudgetManager are no longer production economic admission authorities.
Legacy quota Firestore is bootstrap/projection only after Treasury entitlement initialization.
Production providerFactory execution requires Treasury context and the canonical IntelligentRouter.
Unknown paid pricing remains denied and additional model attempts require fresh Treasury reservations.

conflicts.originalConflict: Economic Intelligence could become a second economic authority if recommendations were allowed to mutate Treasury.
conflicts.proposedResolution: Expose a read-only Treasury ledger projection with no mutation capability and keep all admission decisions in the Constitutional Kernel.
conflicts.acceptedResolution: TreasuryEconomicIntelligence and TreasuryEconomicAdvice expose measurements/recommendations only; no Treasury service handle is exposed to cognition.

conflicts.originalConflict: Legacy quota storage could remain a competing production admission authority during migration.
conflicts.proposedResolution: Use Treasury entitlement accounts for hot-path reads/admission; allow legacy Firestore only for one-time bootstrap and compatibility projection.
conflicts.acceptedResolution: TreasuryQuotaAdmission owns quota admission and current quota reads while Firestore receives projections.

conflicts.originalConflict: Capability and mission components could continue authorizing spend independently through legacy governors.
conflicts.proposedResolution: Keep capability and mission lifecycle checks local, but move economic admission exclusively to Treasury.
conflicts.acceptedResolution: CapabilityFirstRouter no longer calls CostGovernor and MissionManager no longer delegates economic admission to MissionBudgetManager.

conflicts.originalConflict: Specialized legacy endpoints and scheduler paths could bypass the canonical Treasury-gated generation path.
conflicts.proposedResolution: Collapse compatibility generation routes into the canonical path and make scheduler admission-free.
conflicts.acceptedResolution: /api/generations delegates to /api/generate-video, scheduler triggers canonical generation, and specialized quiz/model endpoints use the Treasury-aware provider gateway.

forgerPlan: Forge Architect, Forge Builder, Forge Security and Forge Release reviewed the Wave 4 authority-retirement and advisory-intelligence contract.
